checks.text: The page heading is "Compound Interest Calc" and the default result summary shows "Final balance: $10,000.00" and "Total interest: $0.00" when all inputs are at their defaults.

Typing 10000 in the field labelled "Principal", 5 in the field labelled "Annual rate %", 10 in the field labelled "Years", and selecting "Monthly" in the select labelled "Compounding", then clicking "Calculate" updates the summary to "Final balance: $16,470.09" and "Total interest: $6,470.09".
After the calculation in A2, the breakdown table contains a row for Year 1 with "Interest earned: $500.00" and "Balance: $10,500.00".
After the calculation in A2, the chart tab shows an SVG line chart with a tooltip that, when hovered over the point for Year 10, displays "Year 10: $16,470.09".

Clicking the button "Save scenario" with the default name field empty saves a scenario named "Scenario 1" and the list under "Saved scenarios" shows an item containing "Scenario 1" and "Final: $16,470.09".

Typing "Retirement" in the field labelled "Scenario name" and clicking "Save scenario" adds a list item containing "Retirement" and "Final: $16,470.09"; clicking "Delete Retirement" removes that item from the list.

Changing the select labelled "Compounding" to "Quarterly" and clicking "Calculate" updates the summary to "Final balance: $16,470.09" and "Total interest: $6,470.09" for the same principal, rate and years as A2.
Clicking the button "Copy result" copies the text "Final balance: $16,470.09\nTotal interest: $6,470.09" to the clipboard and shows the message "Copied".
Reload keeps the saved scenario "Retirement" in the list under "Saved scenarios" with the text "Final: $16,470.09".
